title: lazytex-release
description: manifest.json of a release of lazytex or of a child repo. See docs/formats.md.

release.description: The release name: the git tag of the GitHub release. The releaseArchive URLs of the index files name it. "development" for a build that is never published.

repository.description: The GitHub repository of the release, OWNER/REPO.

texlive.description: The TeX Live release of the TeX files (as 'texlive' in the index).

sources.description: The sources of the build: the engine's source archives (attached to lazytex's release as the assets in 'asset'), the inputs that the release only links to, and last, the release's own repository at its commit. A child release has the parent's sources, and then its own repository.

name.description: The source, for example texlive-source, busytex or nixpkgs. For the release's own repository: OWNER/REPO.

version.description: The upstream version, if the source has one.

commit.description: The git commit, if the source is a repository. null for the own repository in a build that is not assembled.

url.description: The upstream source: the archive, or the repository at its commit.

asset.description: The asset name of the attached archive (sources/<asset> in the assembled release).

files.description: Every other file of the release (except release-notes.md and sources/), by path, with its size and SHA-512. A file marked parent is not in this release: the app gets it from the parent release, at the same path.

parent.description: Only in a child release: the parent release (lazytex's), whose files the child uses. The files marked parent come from it.
